title: Complete procedural-story owner: all rounds, causal story, foreknowledge and durable evidence

reviews.classification: complete large story/generation/trope/causal-world palette and execution chronology; prior selected folds promoted after full reading
reviews.disposition:
All1280 pre-fold lines were read in complete consecutive1–150,151–300,301–450,451–600,601–750,751–900,901–1050,1051–1200,1201–1280 slices. This covers all fourteen rounds, every A–CD table, PS-AD/PS-AR/PS-AU renames, P26–P40 return table, OD15/RR direction and B288/B393/B400/B401/B403 followthrough. The prior selected owner folds are included in this complete body review; none substitutes for the earlier unread palette. No linked report, raw draft, source book, code, log or original saved receipt was read by proxy.

**Use current authority and later chronology.** P3/P4 unmerged, P34 in flight, missing story deck and not-yet-integrated source claims are superseded in the later fold by specific integration/receipt evidence. Preserve S-1–S-5's actual staged source/native fixture identities, typed outcomes, funded asks, observer recaps and bounded runner rather than treating all stages as proposals or all later systems as delivered. Historical Village-first, first-prestige, port/model/cost estimates, eight-news/history caps and merge/push cadence are not the current build queue or new authority. Current [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [lead-life rules](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), AD33/AD36/AD43/AD51/AD52 and actual owners govern selected work; AD42 keeps human review optional. NPC-heavy generation and testbed depth do not become mandatory prerequisites for current lead/source worlds.

**Causal story is a consumer, not a substitute for mechanisms.** Actual actor, body, means, place, time, stocks, agreed terms and settlement produce the event; expression, genre, recap, reputation, attributed account and supernatural story reward are separate readers. A trope may recognize, frame or weight an eligible opportunity, but cannot invent an opponent/resource, force betrayal, resurrect a removed cause or settle an impossible action. Real narrative causality can itself be a world mechanism, including strong or free variants. Quiet life, repeated useful work and satisfying simple growth need no obligatory crisis, moral dilemma, loss, hidden drawback or new stat. A completed arc can rest; not every payoff owes loose ends, every failure a compensating reward or every solved mystery a replacement mystery. Actual renewed circumstances can justify genuine repeated gains without replaying one settled commitment.

**A saved stream is not a complete future.** A3/BN4's saved-draw shorthand does not by itself fix future eligibility, other actors' choices, inputs, ordering or world state. Do not consume live draws, reveal frozen hidden results or promise an exact event from a seed alone. Counterfactuals, prophecy, deterministic simulation, remote observation and actual future sight have different declared knowledge/source contracts; a genuine exact faculty need not be weakened by generic uncertainty. Historical canon knowledge remains an accurate record of its source branch, while a changed causal dependency can invalidate the corresponding prediction. There is no automatic per-intervention accuracy tax, universal foreknowledge decay or compulsory in-world price. An exact cause removed can avert an event completely; no blanket duty to preserve recognizable canon, replace its role or make its old growth function happen elsewhere. Independently supported motives/means may still lead to another event. Cross-world residue and a powerful visitor follow actual carriers and local laws rather than a balance-matched rank.

**Claims, observation and secrecy.** Same event, private actor knowledge, public account, chapter truth, player knowledge and character means remain distinct. Salience, names, rumors, kinship, promises, attendance, technique, source lineage and memory require real identity/channel/history; a generated cast cannot acquire invented lived participation on first inspection. A source-supported exception can let absent/dead characters communicate, so AN1 checks the actual mechanism rather than banning every such scene. Recaps and why views read permitted causes/deltas, not developer truth. Full self stats, known terms and reliable save/error feedback stay accurate; fictional deception does not misreport a successful transaction. Learned facts retain basis/time and may conflict without a fake universal truth-probability scale. A late disclosure does not rewrite an old observation. Counts, IDs, tags, sort, price, hover and accessibility fields can all leak; a sentinel or lexical scan checks its path rather than proving complete semantic secrecy. Deliberate dramatic irony is its own selected perspective, not an accidental hidden-state reveal.

**Architecture, clocks and durable history.** Shared typed references and existing receipt/knowledge/request owners avoid competing truth; they do not require one giant log, one global tag ontology, a universal event engine or another save key before a useful slice. Current consumer semantics determine which consequential magnitudes and references must survive compaction. Biography, feed text, aggregate summaries, templates, seed and entity parent IDs are not playable branch archives, exact causal history or permanent idempotence proof. Published paid work cannot be undone to redraw; pre-commit input grace differs from an actual time-reversal faculty with its own carrier/settlement law. Body/world clock, elapsed supported routine, browser-closed absence, banked time and independent remote work remain separate. The512-boundary budget returns a remainder and does not prove a frame budget or completed catch-up. LOD follows causal relevance, not merely visibility; promotion/demotion preserves actual obligations, stocks, known facts and committed outcomes. Scheduling, sort, integer-weight and caching changes need version/input/tie compatibility; BL1's generator rule is not automatic authority to replace every native Math.random or wall-clock measurement.

**Proof and optional tools.** Current report/source labels, corpus/template/profile counts, sparse schemas, metadata tags and old benchmark estimates do not qualify source fidelity, dialogue meaning, safe all-branch export, native behavior or enjoyable long play. A headless soak is a scoped diagnostic, not the sole evidence for fun/accessibility/desktop flow. P34's earlier natural acquisition and final replay from an earned pending fixture retain distinct bundle/scope. The later Melvor fetch failures establish no new two-game comparison or current offline cap. Director controls, runtime LLM expression, logs, taste learning, local exports, old-save legends, audio, archives, automatic policies and role-split authoring remain separately selected proposals. No new model run, telemetry, personal-save access, source acquisition, worker, test/build/browser, gameplay, migration, deletion, relocation, commit or push was performed. Current target viewports and14/21px, truthful focus/return/control feedback and source-qualified authored paths govern a real future consumer.
reviews.evidence: Actual1280 input lines read consecutively in eight150-line slices and final80; every table/later fold included and no truncation. No original linked source/runtime/draft/log/personal-save evidence read by proxy.
reviews.reopen: Use named narrative/source/consumer/clock and current actual authority; keep historical prototype/merge evidence, unseen source questions and genuine power/causal alternatives distinct.
